Identify opportunities to automate repetitive support, monitoring, and reporting activities. Essential Job Functions Ticket and Incident Management Record complete and accurate ticket information. Troubleshooting Review logs, alerts, error messages, application behavior, and configuration. Perform basic API, database, network, identity, and application checks. Document findings, evidence, and resolution steps. Monitoring and Reporting Monitor application, infrastructure, and service dashboards. Assist in configuring alerts and operational reports. Identify recurring incidents, trends, and automation opportunities. Knowledge Management Create and update runbooks and support documentation. Convert resolved incidents into reusable knowledge articles. Support user education and self-service content. Familiarity with Windows and Linux fundamentals. Strong troubleshooting, communication, documentation, organization, and customer-service skills. Willingness to participate in support coverage based on business and team requirements. Preferred Skills Exposure to ServiceNow, Jira Service Management, Azure DevOps, or a similar ticketing platform. Familiarity with REST APIs, SQL, Git, Docker, and Kubernetes. Exposure to Azure Monitor, Application Insights, Log Analytics, Grafana, Prometheus, Sentry, or similar tools. Awareness of machine learning model monitoring and AI product behavior. Understanding of incident, problem, change, knowledge, and service-level management concepts. Familiarity with basic cloud, networking, identity, and security concepts. description: ABOUT LEGAL ENGINEERING The Legal Division advances and protects the interests of the firm by providing high-quality legal advice and helping identify and address legal, regulatory and reputational risk. Legal Engineering supports this mission by designing, building and operating user-facing, workflow, data and AI-enabled platforms that help legal professionals work effectively and make well-informed decisions. Our engineers work directly with business partners and cross-functional teams. We combine modern software engineering, cloud platforms, data capabilities and responsible artificial intelligence to solve complex problems in a controlled environment. YOUR IMPACT As an Analyst or Associate Software Engineer, you will contribute across the full software development lifecycle. You will turn business needs and written specifications into tested, maintainable solutions, while using AI-assisted development tools thoughtfully and remaining accountable for the quality, security and correctness of the resulting code. HOW YOU WILL FULFILL YOUR POTENTIAL Design, develop, test, deploy and support full-stack applications, APIs, workflows and data-processing services used by Legal Division stakeholders. Relevant 1.5 to 2.5 years of experience. Provide ongoing application support and work directly with users to understand and resolve day-to-day needs, questions and production issues; troubleshoot problems, communicate status clearly and implement sustainable fixes that improve reliability and the user experience. Partner with legal professionals, product managers, designers and engineers to understand problems, clarify requirements and deliver practical end-to-end solutions. Participate in a spec-driven design process by helping convert business objectives into clear functional requirements, technical specifications, acceptance criteria, interfaces and test scenarios before implementation. Write clean, maintainable and well-tested code grounded in strong software engineering fundamentals, while effectively leveraging AI-assisted development tools such as Devin, GitHub Copilot and Claude Code to accelerate delivery. Exercise sound engineering judgment by critically evaluating, validating and refining AI-generated solutions to ensure they are correct, secure, scalable and appropriate for the problem being solved. Build intuitive user experiences and reliable backend services using technologies appropriate to the product, including TypeScript, React, Python, Java and API frameworks. Work with structured and unstructured data, including data mapping, transformation, search and integration patterns. Operate collaboratively in an agile environment, communicate trade-offs clearly and continuously learn new technologies and domain concepts. BASIC QUALIFICATIONS Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering or a closely related technical field. Foundational knowledge of computer science concepts, including data structures, algorithms, object-oriented or functional design, databases, networking and software testing. Hands-on programming experience in one or more modern languages. Experience with TypeScript / JavaScript, Python and Java is especially relevant to this role. Experience building or contributing to web applications, backend services or APIs Understanding of software development lifecycle practices, version control, automated testing, continuous integration and deployment concepts. Comfort using AI-assisted development tools such as Devin, GitHub Copilot or Claude Code, together with the judgment to independently inspect, test and challenge generated code rather than accept it without review. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, attention to detail and the ability to communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Intellectual curiosity, sound judgment and a willingness to learn the legal domain, new technologies and emerging AI engineering practices. PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS Experience with relational or NoSQL databases, data modeling, data manipulation or data mapping. Exposure to cloud platforms, containers and orchestration technologies such as Kubernetes. Knowledge of API design, event-driven architectures, search platforms or real-time processing. Experience with modern AI / machine learning ecosystems, including retrieval-augmented generation, agent frameworks, model evaluation or prompt and context engineering. Experience with Microsoft 365 extensibility, including Office.js, is a plus. Interest in financial services, legal technology, compliance, risk or other highly controlled business environments. WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE You deliver working software that meets its specification and acceptance criteria, with appropriate tests and documentation. You use AI-assisted tools to improve development effectiveness without lowering engineering, security or review standards. You identify uncertainty early, ask precise questions and make technical trade-offs visible to stakeholders. You contribute constructively to design discussions, code reviews, operational support and continuous improvement of the team’s engineering practices. CORE TECHNOLOGY EXPOSURE Depending on the product and team, the role may involve: TypeScript, JavaScript, React, Python, FastAPI, Flask, Java, REST APIs, GraphQL, relational and NoSQL databases, search technologies, messaging platforms, Kubernetes, cloud services, automated testing, RAG and agent frameworks, Devin, GitHub Copilot, Claude Code and Office.js. Technology choices vary by solution. Candidates are not expected to have prior experience with every technology listed; strong engineering fundamentals, learning agility and disciplined delivery are essential. description: About Us: Seismic is the Go-To-Market Performance company, driving how organizations turn their strategy into revenue. Learn more at seismic.com. Seismic is committed to building an inclusive workplace that ignites growth for our employees and creates a culture of belonging that allows all employees to be seen and valued for who they are. Learn more about DEI at Seismic here. Overview: We are seeking an experienced Deal Strategy leader to own the deal strategy operations and execution for our high-volume Commercial Segment. This role partners strategically with Sales and Customer Success leadership to drive efficient deal execution at scale, optimize processes, and enable sales teams to navigate complex commercial requirements with minimal friction. The ideal candidate will have hands-on expertise with Salesforce and CPQ (Configure, Price, Quote), a deep understanding of the quote-to-close process, and a proven track record optimizing operations at scale. This individual will lead Commercial segment deal strategy—owning process design, team enablement, and continuous improvement. They'll operate as both a strategic advisor to Sales leadership and hands-on executor, identifying opportunities to streamline workflows, reduce friction, and build repeatable playbooks that accelerate deal velocity. This role requires a strategic, process-oriented leader who can own high-volume operations, lead and mentor team members, drive continuous process improvement, and balance sales enablement with company controls. The ideal candidate combines strong analytical capabilities with operational excellence and the ability to influence and align Sales leadership around deal strategy priorities. Who you are:: 5+ years of experience in Deal Desk, Deal Strategy, Sales Operations, or similar roles, with at least 2+ years in a leadership capacity (team lead, manager, or senior IC with mentoring responsibilities). Advanced hands-on expertise with Salesforce, including custom configuration and workflow optimization. Expert-level hands-on experience with CPQ tools; demonstrated ability to optimize configurations and workflows for process improvement. Extensive experience designing and managing deal processes at scale; demonstrated ability to handle high volumes while maintaining quality and compliance. Proven track record establishing standards and processes for high-volume deal environments. Expert-level understanding of pricing strategies, discount models, and commercial term structuring. Demonstrated experience designing and optimizing approval processes; skilled at coordinating cross-functional teams. Deep expertise in the quote-to-close process and deal lifecycle; ability to identify efficiency opportunities. Extensive experience leading cross-functional partnerships and initiatives; ability to align multiple stakeholder groups. Advanced analytical skills with ability to analyze operational data, identify trends, and drive data-informed improvements. Exceptional attention to detail combined with strong project management and follow-through capabilities. Excellent communication and presentation skills; ability to influence and align leadership on priorities. Ability to manage complex, high-volume operations while maintaining strategic focus and team engagement. What you'll be doing:: Own the end-to-end deal strategy operations for the Commercial Segment; partner closely with Sales and Customer Success leadership to ensure efficient, scalable execution of high-volume deals from initial request through close. Lead the design, optimization, and continuous improvement of Commercial Segment workflows in Salesforce and CPQ; oversee quote creation, pricing logic, and approval processes to maximize efficiency and minimize manual touches. Establish and maintain Commercial Segment deal standards and policies; conduct quality assurance reviews and provide coaching to ensure consistent, compliant deal execution across the high-volume pipeline. Lead analysis of deal structures and commercial patterns; identify optimization opportunities and recommend process improvements that reduce friction, accelerate velocity, and improve profitability across the Commercial Segment. Build and maintain Commercial Segment pricing frameworks, discount models, and playbooks; enable Sales teams with tools, training, and guidance to navigate complex scenarios and make sound decisions with minimal escalation. Own the approval workflow design and SLA management for Commercial deals; drive continuous improvement in approval speed and efficiency while maintaining appropriate controls. Lead CPQ optimization initiatives; troubleshoot system and process issues; partner with Revenue Operations and IT to implement enhancements that improve Commercial deal execution. title: Business Intelligence Engineer, AOP - ROW APEX
description: Description The Analytics Ops and Programs (AOP) team in Hyderabad is looking for an innovative, hands-on, and customer-obsessed Business Intelligence Engineer who wants to work at the intersection of analytics and science. This role sits at a rare vantage point with high growth prospects: on one side are ML/OR models making split-second, cost-saving decisions across the Ops network; on the other is the analytical depth required to understand why those models succeed, where they fall short, and what needs to change. You won't just observe these models from the outside — you'll own them alongside the Scientists. Their performance, their enhancements, and their evolution over time will be your responsibility. When a model needs a new feature, a re-calibrated threshold, or a fundamentally different approach for a particular corridor or condition, you'll be the one driving that forward in partnership with the scientists who built it — and in some cases you'll own those models directly. The technical challenges here are genuinely complex and rewarding. You'll work with large-scale data flowing through automated, near real-time pipelines. You'll design reporting and monitoring frameworks that are as robust as the systems they watch. You'll apply statistical rigor to evaluate model performance in production, design experiments to validate enhancements, and quantify impact in an environment where conditions shift daily. Beyond monitoring, you'll identify what's broken, propose what to build next, and own the analytical path from hypothesis to deployed improvement. This is a role without a single well-worn toolkit — you'll continuously sharpen your skills across data engineering, statistical analysis, and model evaluation to keep pace with the problems in front of you. What makes this role compelling is the combination of ownership and impact. The products you work on drive millions in cost savings for Amazon Ops, and you'll be involved in applied, cutting-edge work. You'll need to be comfortable with ambiguity: many of the most important questions here haven't been cleanly articulated yet — they emerge from patterns in the data, from model behavior that doesn't match expectations, and from edge cases that only surface under certain network conditions. Strong statistical foundations, fluency in SQL, Python, and AWS services, and experience building scalable BI solutions are essential. Your ability to move between deep technical analysis and clear stakeholder communication — and to own outcomes end-to-end rather than just deliver reports — is what will make you exceptional. The ideal candidate is detail-oriented with superior verbal and written communication, strong organizational skills, and excellent technical skills, and is able to juggle multiple tasks at once. You must be able to identify problems before they happen, prioritize accurately, make sound judgments, and get the right things done. This job requires you to constantly hit the ground running and learn quickly. Key job responsibilities Partner with Scientists to own ML/OR models in production — monitoring performance, driving enhancements, and in some cases owning models end-to-end. Apply statistical rigor to evaluate models, design experiments, and quantify business impact. Build scalable, automated data pipelines that inform decision-making and feed model development. Own the design and maintenance of BI solutions, metrics, and reporting/monitoring frameworks. Perform root-cause analysis and ensure data accuracy for new and existing tools and models. Manage projects end-to-end — from data gathering and modeling through to communicating insights and recommendations. Collaborate with Scientists, Data Engineers, SDEs, Product, and Program teams to align deliverables with requirements. A day in the life AOP (Analytics Operations and Programs) team is missioned to standardize BI and analytics capabilities, and reduce repeat analytics/reporting/BI workload for operations across IN, AU, BR, MX, SG, AE, EG, SA marketplace.
